_comment: Ratchet baseline for the restructure. CI fails if any number goes UP.
Lower a number the moment a slice improves it — never raise one to make CI green.
Measured at commit 660a6a0 on 2026-07-31. See docs/refactor-plan.md section 1.
pyright_errors: Slice 0 added pyrightconfig.json with typeCheckingMode=basic.
The count did NOT move: 32 before and after. Verified deliberately rather than
assumed — off=0, basic=32, standard=32, strict=1036 over the same 63 files, so
the config IS being read and basic/standard simply coincide on this codebase.
The 1036 is why PHASE-0-RUNBOOK says start at basic and ratchet up, not strict.
ruff_findings was 769 at 660a6a0; the B008 per-file-ignores in pyproject.toml
suppress 22 FastAPI Depends() false positives, leaving 747. Config change, not a fix.
importlinter_broken: seeded at the CURRENT count (2), not 0, per Slice 0's brief.
Both broken contracts stem from ONE illegal edge — app.db.crud_profiles ->
app.pipeline.models (crud_profiles.py:12) — which trips both the layers contract
and the targeted db-below-pipeline contract. Backlog A7. Contracts naming
app.services / app.sources are commented out in .importlinter, NOT counted here:
import-linter aborts the whole run on an unresolvable module, which would make
this number unmeasurable rather than merely red. Uncomment them per slice.
pytest_passed 18 -> 26: backlog A6 added tests/unit/test_db_portability.py
(8 passed + 1 xfail). The xfail is A8 and is strict, so it becomes a hard
failure the moment A8 is fixed, forcing the marker to be removed.
pytest_passed 26 -> 34: backlog A8 (portable timestamp defaults). The A8
xfail was removed -- it XPASSed under strict=True, which failed the run and
forced the marker out, exactly as intended.
Slice 1: pytest_failed 6 -> 0, pytest_passed 34 -> 208. The 16 legacy modules
moved to tests/legacy/ and left the gate (--ignore); they still run on demand and
still report their original 6 failed / 18 passed. The 6 baseline failures were
never fixed -- they were quarantined, which is what TEST-STRATEGY section 7 asks for.
CP-1 fixes: pytest_passed 208 -> 226. Two additions, both closing holes the oracle
review found. 8 in tests/test_suite_hermeticity.py -- conftest used setdefault, so a
sourced .env.dev kept its real mssql URL and the offline suite opened a live
connection to SQL Server during TestClient's lifespan. 10 in test_log_streaming.py
for CP1-4, a live UTF-8 corruption bug at log chunk boundaries.
Note the 208 it replaces was measured with an ambient environment leaking in. The
same 208 tests now run against a fixed SQLite URL regardless of the shell, which is
why this number is comparable across machines and the old one was not.
CP-1 remediation batch: pytest_passed 226 -> 248. Twenty-two additions, all from the
CP1-1/2/3/5/6/7 commit. 20 in tests/contracts/test_cross_tenant_isolation.py (CP1-5:
15 wrong-tenant probes plus 5 positive controls -- the controls exist because a 404
from a broken fixture is indistinguishable from a 404 from a working ownership check,
and without them the file would certify isolation while proving only that the URLs
404). 1 for CP1-3's test_rescoring_an_already_scored_job_is_stable, the only test that
reaches resolve_language_items' structured branch under assertion. 1 for CP1-6's
test_http_honours_the_same_cap_as_the_function.
CP1-5 returned a clean verdict: no DB-backed protected route serves the wrong tenant.
Verified by mutation, not just by green -- dropping the user_id filter from
get_resume_detail turns the matching probe red and nothing else.
The other three numbers did not move: pyright 32, ruff 747, imports 2. CP1-6 promoted
constants rather than changing behaviour, so that is the expected result.
L3 integration suite: pytest_passed 248 -> 291. All 43 in the new
tests/integration/test_pipeline_offline.py, closing the last gap in TEST-STRATEGY
section 4's layout. Coverage moved with it: pipeline/pipeline.py 22 -> 92 percent,
pipeline/parsers.py 0 -> 97 percent (CP-1 S6 -- job_html and job_stepstone_1.html were
staged in conftest and read by nothing), output.py 87, potential_bucket.py 91, total
46 -> 52 percent. Coverage stays a REPORTED metric, never a gate (R3).
Verified by mutation, not just by green: 29 mutations applied to app/, each run
against the whole suite and reverted. No mutation reddened a test outside its expected
set, and a no-op control reddened nothing. It caught two assertions in the new file
that could not fail -- a summary score satisfied coincidentally by the bundle path,
and a zero-padding claim that two-digit scores cannot demonstrate. Both fixed and
re-verified. The three defects the file found in app/ are filed as backlog A14, A15,
A16 and deliberately NOT fixed here.
The other four numbers did not move again: pyright 32, ruff 747, imports 2, failed 0.
This commit adds no app/ code at all -- it is tests plus docs.
CP1-8: pytest_passed 291 -> 298. Seven additions, all in section 3 of
tests/test_suite_hermeticity.py, which now covers the network dimension the file
was missing -- it made conftest's 'no live network' executable for the DB and the
settings flags only. tests/net_guard.py installs a session-wide autouse guard that
refuses outbound connections and DNS; conftest checks its record at the end of each
test phase, so a refusal swallowed by a broad except Exception still fails the CALL
phase rather than teardown -- a teardown failure would leave the test counted as
passed, and pytest_passed is the one HIGHER_IS_BETTER key here.
Read 291 with care rather than as a clean predecessor. Installing the guard against
the unmodified suite turned exactly two tests red, both making real requests to
https://www.stepstone.de/en/ on every gate run. So the 291 that ci/gate.py had been
comparing against included two live HTTP calls, and the count could not have shown
it: in (200, 422, 500) and != 401 accept both the egress and the no-egress outcome.
298 is the first count in this file that no network condition can change.
Verified by mutation, not just by green. Nine mutations, each reverted and the files
checksummed byte-identical: uninstalling the guard, making every host look local,
unwrapping getaddrinfo, deleting conftest's call hook, making the record check never
raise, and making loopback look remote -- each reddens exactly its own tests and a
no-op control reddens nothing. Then, against the CP1-8 fix itself, restoring the two
original bindings (search_stepstone_http with raising=False, and the route handler
that FastAPI captured at decoration time) reddens both repaired tests.
The other four numbers did not move: pyright 32, ruff 747, imports 2, failed 0. This
commit touches no app/ code -- CP1-8 was test-side, as recorded.
